parts.text: Find the probability that more than 17 of these residents are in favour of the leisure centre.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Find the probability that the 5th person asked is the first person who is not in favour of the leisure
centre.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
Find the probability that the 7th person asked is the second person who is not in favour of the
leisure centre.

text: 80% of the residents of Kinwawa are in favour of a leisure centre being built in the town.
20 residents of Kinwawa are chosen at random and asked, in turn, whether they are in favour of the
leisure centre.
The probability that it will rain on any given day is x. If it is raining, the probability that Aran wears
a hat is 0.8 and if it is not raining, the probability that he wears a hat is 0.3. Whether it is raining or
not, if Aran wears a hat, the probability that he wears a scarf is 0.4. If he does not wear a hat, the
probability that he wears a scarf is 0.1. The probability that on a randomly chosen day it is not raining
and Aran is not wearing a hat or a scarf is 0.36.
Find the value of x. [3]
Marco has four boxes labelled K, L, M and N. He places them in a straight line in the order K, L, M,
N with K on the left. Marco also has four coloured marbles: one is red, one is green, one is white
and one is yellow. He places a single marble in each box, at random. Events A and B are defined as
follows.
A: The white marble is in either box L or box M.
B: The red marble is to the left of both the green marble and the yellow marble.
Determine whether or not events A and B are independent. [3]

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Find the probability that a randomly chosen cyclist has a time less than 74 minutes.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Find the probability that 4 randomly chosen cyclists all have times between 50 and 74 minutes.

In a different cycling event, the times can also be modelled by a normal distribution. 23% of the
cyclists have times less than 36 minutes and 10% of the cyclists have times greater than 54 minutes.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text: Find estimates for the mean and standard deviation of this distribution.

text: In a cycling event the times taken to complete a course are modelled by a normal distribution with
mean 62.3 minutes and standard deviation 8.4 minutes.
